front_blocks.md: Define **inert** (in the context of addition polymers).

back_blocks.md: An **inert** substance is one that does not readily react with other chemicals. Addition polymers are chemically **inert** due to their strong **C-C bonds**, which makes them resistant to **biodegradation**.
